title: MEIKO — Necessary Distance〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hi, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Hello, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, welcome...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Welcome, Ena, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
You're back already...?
Please try to keep it down.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Okay, we will.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: MEIKO...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: She's had something on her mind for quite some time now...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see. Then we probably shouldn't bother her...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But what is it that's bothering her so much?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: More importantly, where are Mafuyu and Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: They're still at school, so it's just us for now.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: So that's that. Actually, it's pretty rare for Mizuki to go to school at all.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Anyways, what bring you two here?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, it's about this trip we all went on the other day.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah! Mizuki took a ton of pictures and just sent them over to us. We thought that we should show you.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yes, you mentioned something about that.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What kind of pictures...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: They're on my phone so just give me one... Here they are!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You did it to help Kanade, yes? Were you able to make your song...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. I managed.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: So it became a good experience.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Good? I'd say it was more shocking than it was good. The tunnel Mizuki took us through in the beginning was so creepy...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Tunnel?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, here. Every place Mizuki took us was supposedly haunted in some way.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Such a dark and eerie atmosphere too. It constantly felt like something could jump out and come after us at any time...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Could...? But nothing did in the end?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We probably wouldn't be here if that did happen!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Kanade, how about this one...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, that's from the second place we saw.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you for telling us about your trip, Kanade, Ena.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, it was sort of interesting.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I'm glad.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We'll see you later!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Bye, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Bye.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I didn't get to see Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: True, but Mizuki's at school. There isn't much we can do about that, right?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is it still bothering you...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
A little.
I wish I had more to work with...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Didn't Mizuki mention to Mafuyu that they were somehow alike...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But still, I just sort of got the feeling we were somehow alike.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That part that feels like we might be able to change ourselves a bit at a time to fit in with those around us, and the confusion at whether we should resist or accept it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Then getting so tired from trying so hard that nothing seems to matter anymore. I feel like we're similar in that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: There aren't very many people who can understand how that feels.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And that's why I think I'd feel really sad if you were to disappear now.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: The self...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Perhaps Mizuki's also doing some soul searching...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You think so...? I feel like Mizuki already has a clear sense of self.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I mean, Mizuki always bring me things that are "cute", like ribbons, clothes and stuff.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You don't seem satisfied with that answer...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I don't? I understand what you're trying to say Rin, but...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But...?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: No, nevermind...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (There's no point in telling them now. I need more information...)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: (I need more time to find what I'm looking for...)
